description: Even 4-count box: inhale, hold, exhale, hold. A simple steadying pattern for focus.
name: Box Breathing 4-4-4-4

phases.instruction: Inhale slowly through your nose for 4 counts.
phases.label: Inhale

phases.instruction: Hold the breath for 4 counts. Relax your shoulders.
phases.label: Hold

phases.instruction: Exhale gently through your nose or mouth for 4 counts.
phases.label: Exhale

phases.instruction: Hold empty for 4 counts, then begin the next round.
phases.label: Hold
